major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Blades
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use only when at least one charge of Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are ready; sync with potions and on-use trinkets for maximum burst.

major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Dance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Only press when Secret Technique is ready, except for the second charge inside the Shadow Blades window; hold charges when Shadow Blades is within 30 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Secret Technique
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast as the top-priority finisher inside every Shadow Dance window; may be used outside Shadow Dance only when Shadow Dance has 10 or more seconds remaining on cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown at 0-2 combo points to enable Shadow Strike via Premeditation; prioritise utility uses such as interrupts or mechanic solves over pure damage.

rules.description: Pair Secret Technique with Shadow Dance
rules.action: Cast Secret Technique as your first or second finisher inside every Shadow Dance window — using it outside Shadow Dance when Shadow Dance has fewer than 10 seconds of cooldown remaining is a major DPS loss.

rules.description: Hold Shadow Dance and SecTech before Shadow Blades
rules.action: When Shadow Blades is less than 30 seconds from coming off cooldown, stop spending Shadow Dance charges and hold Secret Technique so you enter Shadow Blades with both available.

rules.description: Only use Shadow Blades with Shadow Dance ready
rules.action: Press Shadow Blades only when you have at least one charge of Shadow Dance available — using it without Shadow Dance wastes the doubled combo point generation and the shared damage amplification window.

rules.description: Enter Shadow Dance at correct combo point count
rules.action: As Trickster, enter Shadow Dance at 6-7 combo points so you can immediately open with Secret Technique. As Deathstalker, enter at 0-1 combo points so Premeditation fills your bar on the first Shadowstrike.

rules.description: Second Shadow Dance timing during Shadow Blades
rules.action: Use your second Shadow Dance charge immediately when the first expires during Shadow Blades, but do not spend it if Shadow Blades has fewer than 10 seconds remaining — preserve charges for the next Shadow Blades cycle.
Press Shadow Dance before the pull to carry two Supercharger charges into combat, giving your first two finishers the power equivalent of 10 combo points.

rules.description: Swap to Shuriken Storm and Black Powder at 2+ targets
rules.action: At 2 or more targets replace Backstab with Shuriken Storm and Eviscerate with Black Powder; inside Shadow Dance at 4 or more targets use Shuriken Storm over Shadowstrike entirely.
Always position behind the boss when using Backstab — it deals increased damage from behind and bosses can only parry attacks coming from the front.

source_summary: Subtlety Rogue in Midnight concentrates nearly all damage inside cooldown windows: Shadow Blades should only be used when Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are both ready, Secret Technique must always be cast inside Shadow Dance, and both cooldowns must be held for the 30 seconds before Shadow Blades resets. Outside of cooldowns the spec is intentionally energy-starved with low output, so pool energy before pressing Shadow Dance, use macros to chain it with a finisher or builder immediately, and exploit Premeditation by entering Shadow Dance and Vanish at the correct combo point count for your chosen hero talent.
